name: Daikokuya Holdings Co.,Ltd.
summary: Daikokuya Holdings Co.,Ltd. operate pawnbroker business in Japan. It operates through the Electrical Equipment Business and Pawnbroking and Secondhand Goods Sales Business segments. The company offers industrial lighting fixtures, which include explosion-proof type and sealed anti-corrosion lighting equipment, hand lamp and emergency /portable explosion proof lighting equipment; industrial electric circuit plumbing fittings, such as explosion-proof type, sealed and waterproof electric circuit piping fixture, pull box, and waterproof flexible tube.
